purpose: Preserve what the inspected official service-page snapshots support, their reported crawl age and the boundaries that must not be inferred.

method.retrieval: Read-only page opening and indexed search excerpts on 2026-11-21.
method.crawl_age_rule: Crawl ages are approximate ages reported by the retrieval layer. They are not source publication dates, direct HTTP status, a live availability check or proof that page contents changed at that time.
method.cache_miss_rule: A cache miss records only that the page body was not returned by the read path. It is not a 404, outage or proof of unavailability.
method.claim_rule: Observed page wording supports only that a claim appears in the inspected snapshot. It does not establish current contract scope, price, SLA, service capacity, rights or inclusion in every project.
exclusions: No live HTTP status, redirect chain, robots/indexing state or form workflow was tested.
No current legal terms, prices, project contracts or rights grants were authenticated.

routes.rights_observation: The page-level rights-transfer wording is observed; the exact rights grant for a specific project, media, territory, term and sublicensing is not established.
scope_limits: A page-level list is not a project-specific specification or signed agreement.

routes.recommended_refresh: Refresh the page and verify the current brief and contract template; clarify the exact rights variables before any buyer-facing rights promise.
